economicBlockers.remainingAssumption: How much of current parent cash can be deployed while preserving operating resilience, jointly with observed-scale deposit runoff and investment/lease budget. No private-contract date or arbitrary owner approval demanded.
economicBlockers.smallestResolution: A defensible public-evidence operating cash/funding response range showing enough deployable liquidity, or retain constrained/N/R stress judgment. Approval cannot create liquidity or justify selecting only favorable endpoint.
